filename: Co-production of climate services_ challenges and enablers_.pdf
title: Co-production of climate services: challenges and enablers
testbed_rationale: Perspective article discussing governance, challenges, and enablers in co-producing climate services; does not produce, analyze, or provide datasets for ML parameterization or physical modeling.
pain_points: Lack of climate observations and local sectoral/societal data in data-sparse regions
Resource-intensive co-production process with high turnover of stakeholders and researchers
Difficulty characterizing, communicating, and managing deep uncertainties and wildcard events
Disconnect and power asymmetries between scientific providers and diverse stakeholder decision contexts
Lack of independent evaluation metrics and standardization schemes for climate services
extraction_notes: Perspective article focused on the practice, institutional frameworks, and challenges of transdisciplinary climate services co-development; no ML algorithms or benchmark datasets were used or developed.
